fr.title: Bécasseau maubèche
fr.extract: Le Bécasseau maubèche est une espèce d'oiseaux Charadriiformes de la famille des Scolopacidae.

en.title: Red knot
en.extract: The red knot or just knot is a medium-sized shorebird which breeds in tundra and the Arctic Cordillera in the far north of Canada, Europe, and Russia. It is the type species of the genus Calidris. Six subspecies are recognised.
